div.head: Geþyn. 2
div.ab: And gif ceorl geþeah, þæt he hæfde V hida fullice agenes landes, . . . bellan 7 burhgeat, setl 7 sundornote on cynges healle, þonne wæs he þanon forð þegenrihtes wyrðe.

And if a ceorl prospered, that he possessed fully five hides of land of his own, a bell and a castle-gate, a seat and a special office in the king's hall, then was he henceforth entitled to the rights of a thegn.
7 gif ceorl geþeah, þæt he hæfde fullice fif hida agenes landes, cirican 7 kycenan, bellhus 7 burhgeat, setl 7 sundernote on cynges healle, þonne wæs he þanon forð þegenrihtes weorðe.

And if a layman prospered so that he had fully five hides of his own property with a church and a kitchen, a bell-house and a fortified gate, a seat and an appointed role in the king's hall, then he was worthy of a thegn's rights ever after.
